Name: Zuzu Obelisk Gwen style retexture
Author: tragco
Description:
This mod changes the default obelisk for the spectacular Downtown Zuzu mod (created by the Zuzu Development Team) to match Gwen's style obelisks. Here is the link to that mod:

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8587]Downtown Zuzu[/url]

I used the Medieval Buildings by Gweniaczek's mod textures in part and am providing the link below (you really should download this and be ready to be amazed at how gorgeous it is). I'm also adding a link to the Medieval Craftables mod because it's a must-have in my opinion.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings by Gweniaczek
[/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5513]Gwen's Medieval Craftables[/url]﻿



To install: Copy and paste the folder into your mods folder.  Be sure you've installed Smapi, Content Patcher, and of course the Downtown Zuzu mod.
